key.name: trigger-button
key.summary: Mouse button used to start a gesture
key.description: Button index used to begin drag tracking. 3 is the right mouse button.

key.name: trigger-threshold
key.summary: Minimum pointer travel distance for gesture recognition
key.description: Smaller values make the gesture easier to trigger. Larger values reduce false positives.

key.name: action-left
key.summary: Command to run for a left swipe

key.name: action-right
key.summary: Command to run for a right swipe

key.name: action-up
key.summary: Command to run for an upward swipe

key.name: action-down
key.summary: Command to run for a downward swipe
